summary: I retested the 5 frontend fixes with Playwright against the public URL. All 5 pass. (1) The portal-only driver vc.driver@pulsefitness.test goes from /login to /staff-portal, and area-switcher-btn is not rendered (count 0). (2) /staff-portal?tab=vehicle&vehicle=VCTEST_vehicle opens the form. Back returns to the list and the URL becomes ?tab=vehicle, and a reload shows the list. After submit the URL is also cleared. (3) vehicle-extra-photo has the multiple attribute. Selecting 2 images uploads both (2 POST 200s and 2 thumbnails). Removing one, saving the draft and reloading keeps the correct single fid. Removing the last photo, saving and reloading gives an empty set. (4) Cookie banner: the accept and decline buttons are hit-test clean at 4 points each at 1920x800 and 390x844. Nothing covers them (ask-orb-btn z50 and gx-feedback-launcher z40 are under the banner z60). (5) I completed all 28 items with notes and 1 extra photo and submitted. The owner portal@pulsefitness.ltd goes to /launch, then Operations, Staffing, Vehicles, Weekly checks, Open. check-detail-driver-notes shows the note text and the photo loads (naturalWidth 64).

minor.issue: Returns 403 on every Staff Portal load for the portal-only driver. The UI is not affected, but it is console noise and a wasted request. Skip cross-login for users without CRM access.

issues: After the check is Submitted, the card still shows a 'Complete check' CTA. It opens a read-only form, so label it 'View check'.

Multi-select uploads run one after another, about 3s per photo. The only feedback is the 'Uploading…' label, with no count (e.g. 1/2). If the user saves mid-upload, the photos still uploading are not included in that save.
The Week commencing / From / To filters use the browser's native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar.

action_items: Optional: change the CTA to 'View check' when the check is submitted
Optional: show upload progress (n/N) for multi-photo selection
Optional: stop calling /api/crm/auth/cross-login for portal-only staff (403 noise)
critical_code_review_comments: StaffPortal.js closeCheck rebuilds the URL as `${pathname}?${sp}`. If sp is empty, this leaves a trailing '?'. This is harmless but untidy.
DriverNotesCard puts the JWT in the img src query string (?auth=${jwt}), which can leak it in logs and Referer headers. Prefer the cookie session or short-lived signed URLs.
